editorial:
Imagine a world where a dark secret from the past comes back to ruin everything. You get to follow a mysterious woman played by Isabelle Huppert, who brings a cold and scary energy to the screen. Since Dario Argento is directing, you know the movie looks bright and bold, even when things get creepy. The story is based on an old Mexican film, so it has that classic feel but with a modern twist. It feels like a nightmare you cannot wake up from, filled with strange coincidences and a lot of tension that keeps you on the edge of your seat.

What really works here is the acting and the way the plot twists around when you least expect it. The pacing is mostly steady, though some parts might feel a bit slow if you want non-stop action. However, the payoff at the end makes it all worth it. If you enjoy psychological thrillers, you should definitely check this out. You can rent it on Apple TV for a quick watch, or if you want the best picture, add the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection to see all the vivid colors.
endingExplained: The big twist reveals that the main character has been living a lie about her own identity. You find out that she is actually the one responsible for the crimes she was investigating. In the final scene, the truth comes out in a shocking way that leaves her with nothing. She ends up trapped by her own guilt and the police, bringing a dark and sad conclusion to the whole mystery.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves psychological puzzles and stylish horror.
